name: ig-design-system
description: Infragistics design system: design tokens generated with igniteui-theming, plus the checks that keep sites consistent.

scripts.build: node src/make.ts && node src/migration.ts docs/MIGRATION.md && node src/namespace.ts && node src/dtcg.ts dist/tokens.json dist/theme.css dist/infragistics.tokens.json && tsc -p tsconfig.seed.json
scripts.check: node checks/lint.ts reference/components && node checks/check-vars.ts dist/tokens.css dist/theme.css reference && node checks/spacing-roles.ts reference && node checks/gates-derived.ts && node checks/gates-themes.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check
